name: Tantric Buddhism in India and Tibet

assessments.name: Live Intellectual Participation
assessments.description: Genuine, prepared, respectful engagement. Quiet students can do well by submitting strong questions, contributing in small groups, and listening generously.

assessments.name: Weekly 2Q/2C Tickets
assessments.description: Two questions and two comments on the week's materials. The aim is intellectual preparation, not performance — so the class becomes a real conversation.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task
assessments.description: You will answer 5 brief questions. This task is required but does not contribute to your final mark. It is designed to give you some feedback early in the unit.

assessments.name: Modes of Knowing
assessments.description: An analytical paper comparing what different forms of access (text, image, voice, practice, AI) can and cannot reveal about Buddhist knowledge.

assessments.name: Concept Lab Facilitation
assessments.description: Choose one concept, passage, image, practice, or debate and activate it as a problem for the class. You are not summarising — you are facilitating inquiry.
assessments.type: In-person practical, skills, or performance task or test

assessments.name: Major Essay (Capstone)
assessments.description: An original scholarly argument on a question of your design, anchored in course material and developed under guidance.
